change.after: "SHA-384 for RSA 3072-bit keys, SHA-512 for RSA 4096-bit keys"

of.needed: whether systems that consume or validate these certificates fail to handle SHA-384/SHA-512 signatures

consequence.statement: As 3072-bit and 4096-bit RSA keys rotate, the certificates use SHA-384 or SHA-512. The upgrade guide expects these to be widely supported, but errors are possible.
consequence.remediation: After larger RSA keys rotate, watch for errors from systems that consume these certificates.

assertion.statement: From cert-manager 1.17.0, RSA certificates with 3072-bit keys use SHA-384 and those with 4096-bit keys use SHA-512 as the hash algorithm. Operators should check for errors as these larger RSA keys rotate.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for protocol-behavior behavior-changed
